reviewed_boundaries: Current sealed source cannot retrofit terminal freeze/export/import
Protocol-wide lifecycle guard, proved pre-terminal abort and irreversible terminal commit
Finalized terminal source proof before one successor activates; proof/attestation authority remains unselected
Exact IDs/ordinals/traits/remaining inventory, shares and complete LP/royalty ledgers including fractions
Complete imported population denominators even with lazy asset rows
Atomic immutable raw-balance cutoff and one-time captured-delta settlement; no moving pending balances
Classified full backing; no principal budget haircut to funded liabilities
Legacy immutable royalty/creator receivers, tagged one-use forwarding and strictly increasing successor epochs
Actual finality, gas, contract-owner compatibility, service routes, data availability and independent audit remain gates

production_enumeration_review.mode: Read-only working-source inspection, no tests or RPC calls; excluded frontend work is not published by this report

findings.detail: Explicit reservation identities/assets/observed blocks and independent evidence; no funded-count or Active-state assumption. Offline manifest consistency is not remote delivery or live permanent capacity proof.
An explicit bucket must match local pool and Active custody before valuation; None cannot generate sampled LP revenue.
Canonical minted NFT identity, owner, shares and royalty eligibility drive NFT positions, not admitted bucket count.
PoolReserved is raw decoded metadata, not an NFT mint/ownership event.
Only production count/ordinal enumerators located; both skip None before financial reads. Existing separate two-case keeper receipt was not rerun.

limitations: Internal documentation/design/source review is not independent audit or production approval.
Execution receipts are linked and scope-checked, not rerun by this reviewer.
External URLs and actual production dependencies were not network-tested.
A later document/candidate change requires refreshed matching hashes/link observations.
